# MapanSetu User Guide (TEST/DEMO MATERIAL)

Welcome to MapanSetu. This platform helps businesses manage their Legal Metrology certifications online.

## Getting Started
To get started, businesses must register an account and complete their profile. Once registered, you can apply for new certificates, renew existing ones, and track inspection statuses.

## Inspection Workflow
An assigned officer will visit your premises on the scheduled date. Ensure all instruments are accessible. The officer will submit a report through the MapanSetu field app.
